species.name: Whale
species.rule: Total 30-day PnL in the top tenth of the herd.
species.description: Rarely seen and impossible to miss. Moves slowly through the deep end of the leaderboard and displaces more than the rest of the plain together.

species.name: Hyena
species.rule: Wins at least ten points less often than the herd's median win rate, yet earns more than the median wallet.
species.description: Laughs at its own win rate. Loses often and small, then walks off with the whole carcass.
species.cutoff: This season: win rate of 38% or less, PnL above $1.14M.

species.name: Fox
species.rule: Wins at least ten points more often than the herd's median win rate, on no more than the median number of trades.
species.description: Small, quick and precise. Hunts seldom and rarely misses; distrusts any trade it has not watched for a week.
species.cutoff: This season: win rate of 58% or more, 1,404 trades or fewer.

species.name: Tortoise
species.rule: Fewer trades than three-quarters of the herd, with an average trade ROI above the herd's median.
species.description: Slow by choice. A handful of trades a month, each carried to the end; outlives faster things by not hurrying.
species.cutoff: This season: 706 trades or fewer, average ROI above +108%.

species.name: Hummingbird
species.rule: In the busiest quarter of the herd by trades, or above-median trades spread across one of the widest quarter of token lists.
species.description: Never still. Sips from a hundred tokens a day and burns most of what it takes on the flying.
species.cutoff: This season: 3,070 trades or more, or 1,404+ trades across 44+ tokens.

species.name: Elephant
species.rule: Holds more tokens right now than three-quarters of the herd.
species.description: Keeps everything. A long memory and a longer list of holdings; moves the ground when it moves at all.
species.cutoff: This season: 19 tokens held or more.

species.name: Meerkat
species.rule: Every wallet no other species claims: modest PnL, unremarkable habits, one of the mob.
species.description: The commonest animal on the plain. Small, consistent, forever up on hind legs scanning for what the others have seen.
species.cutoff: This season: everything the six rules above did not claim.
